title: Level 1
subtitle: Just a normal walk | 1x Harder
initialHint: Walk right to enter the door
hint: The ground right before the exit door drops as you cross x:480! Jump early from the left platform across the opening.

title: Level 2
subtitle: Don't look down | 10x Harder
initialHint: A stable bridge... or is it?
hint: Every orange platform will crumble instantly upon touch. Keep sprinting and hop continuously across the bridge without stopping!

title: Level 3
subtitle: Copycats | 100x Harder
initialHint: Jump over the spikes... if they let you
hint: These spikes copy your jump! Bait them by jumping from far away (x:260), then walk underneath while they are up in the air!

title: Level 4
subtitle: Where are you going? | 1,000x Harder
initialHint: The door is playing hard to get
hint: The door flees right, and then runs all the way back to the left wall (x:100). Chase it right, then turn around to catch it on the left!

title: Level 5
subtitle: Watch your head | 10,000x Harder
hint: DO NOT JUMP in the middle hallway! Jumping triggers the crushing ceiling to smash down. Simply walk on the floor to the exit.

title: Level 6
subtitle: Too good to be true | 100,000x Harder
initialHint: That was easy... wait a minute
hint: Jump right onto the raised ledge, then touch the center door. Return to the ledge and jump left into the real portal!

title: Level 7
subtitle: Gravity has left the chat | 1,000,000x Harder
initialHint: Keep your feet on the... ceiling?
hint: Crossing x:320 flips gravity to the ceiling! Once on the ceiling, jump downwards to dodge the hanging spikes at x:480.

title: Level 8
subtitle: Brain lag | 10^7x Harder
initialHint: Your keyboard might feel weird soon
hint: At x:280, left & right arrow keys are flipped! Press LEFT to move right and safely leap across the middle stone island.

title: Level 9
subtitle: Seeing is not believing | 10^8x Harder
initialHint: The solid platform is a lie
hint: The upper platform at x:260 is fake and you will fall through. Land directly onto the invisible ledge slightly lower down!

title: Level 10
subtitle: To infinity and beyond | 10^9x Harder
hint: Approaching the door launches it like a rocket. It lands on top of the left stone pillar at x:200. Jump on top of the pillar to enter!

title: Level 11
subtitle: Ice, ice, baby | 10^10x Harder
hint: You are on frictionless ice and a hidden spike will thrust upward at x:640. Jump before the end of the ice track to clear the pop-up spike!

title: Level 12
subtitle: Watch above | 10^11x Harder
hint: Ceiling boulders fall at x:210, x:370, and x:530. Inch forward to trigger each drop, step back, and then walk past safely.

title: Level 13
subtitle: High voltage trampoline | 10^12x Harder
hint: Ceiling spikes sit straight above the bouncy trampoline. The second you hit the trampoline, steer HARD RIGHT in mid-air toward the high ledge!

title: Level 14
subtitle: Lights out | 10^13x Harder

params.text: Watch your step in the dark! 🔦

hint: In the dark, floor spikes lurk at x:340 and x:550. Jump onto the elevated platforms at x:250 and x:450 to pass over them safely.

title: Level 15
subtitle: The Final Gauntlet | 10^14x Harder
initialHint: Everything you've learned. Do not panic.
hint: Jump early across the dropping ground, trigger the jumping spike by hopping in place, walk without jumping under the ceiling, and corner the door!

title: Level 16
subtitle: Titanium Highway | 10^15x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Ascend the rising terrace steps carefully. Bait the leaping spike on the middle ledge at x:311 by jumping from a distance before leaping across.

title: Level 17
subtitle: The Phantom Ledge | 10^16x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Descend into the canyon island at x:343. Watch the ceiling! A loose stalactite drops when you reach x:197. Bait it to fall first.

title: Level 18
subtitle: Velocity Trial | 10^17x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Stepping stones across the void! Stepping past x:356 temporarily reverses steering. Be ready to press LEFT to move right!

title: Level 19
subtitle: Cyber Passage | 10^18x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Wave hopping! Leap from the high ledge at x:166 cleanly over the spike in the middle of the low platform at x:324.

title: Level 20
subtitle: Vortex Monolith | 10^19x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Gravity is completely inverted! You run upside-down along the ceiling. Use short downward hops to clear the downward hanging spikes.

title: Level 21
subtitle: Magnetic Parallax | 10^20x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: High-speed icy slide! A popup spike emerges at x:331 when you cross x:208. Jump early while sliding to clear it.

title: Level 22
subtitle: Obsidian Horizon | 10^21x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: The chasm is bridged by invisible stepping stones at x:[162, 333, 510]. Trust your leaps and hop firmly across!

subtitle: Infernal Catapult | 10^22x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Rapid collapse gauntlet! Every platform crumbles under your feet within 0.248s. Full forward sprint with uninterrupted hops!

subtitle: Apex Chasm | 10^23x Harder
hint: Tactical Clue: Bouncy pad at x:155! Hold RIGHT the instant you hit the trampoline to curve around the ceiling spike and land on the high ledge at x:285.

subtitle: Labyrinth of Threshold | 10^24x Harder
